text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let the Curren Chan Special Holiday ★
Meet and
Greet begin!

text_block_list.name: Curren Fans
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa!
Curren!
It all started a few hours earlier...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yep! You know how I was just nominated
for
Umastagram's "Trendsetter of the
Year"?

I do remember her posting about that. 
Apparently, there's an award for
becoming a hot
trend on Umastagram
each year.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I wanna celebrate that and thank my
fans for all
their support directly!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if they weren't following me, I
wouldn't
have been nominated, right?

Since she cares so much about her fans,
this might be a good chance for her to
enjoy herself. Just as
I try to ask about
how she'd like to hold it...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's get going! A lot of fans are
already
lined up.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's get going! A lot of fans are
already
lined up.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: We're going to open up the cafeteria early, so I'd be awfully grateful if you could help me out a bit!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yep!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Already did! I got permission and made
all the necessary arrangements,
including reserving the
cafeteria and
posting the announcement!
choice_data_list: Still, what about filing an applic...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I posted a short on Umastagram and
everything...
You didn't even see it, did
you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I posted a short on Umastagram and
everything...
You didn't even see it, did
you?

I totally missed it.
Guilt starts to seep in
for not
helping her out at all, when...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've got an important job for
you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've got an important job for
you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aaand that iiis...
not taking your eyes off
me!
Think you can handle that? ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aaand that iiis...
not taking your eyes off
me!
Think you can handle that? ♪

And so, the fan meeting begins. Just as
she asked, I don't take my eyes off of
her the entire
time she's interacting with
all her fans.

text_block_list.name: Curren Fan A
text_block_list.text:
U-um! C-congratulations on your
n-nomination!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. ♪ I couldn't have done it
without you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Fan A
text_block_list.text:
You're so unbelievably cute in real life!
Like so,
sooo cute!

text_block_list.name: Curren Fan B
text_block_list.text:
We just became fans recently... We love
watching
races and can't wait to see your
next one! We'll
be cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! ♪ As long as I have your
support, I
can run forever. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Fans
text_block_list.text: So cuuute! We'll follow you anywhere!

Perhaps due to her self-promotion
efforts, Curren Chan has picked up some
new fans. WIth this, it looks like we can
consider her goal of raising her profile
accomplished.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thanks, everyone! Bye for now!

text_block_list.name: Curren Fans
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaa!
Bye, Curren!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. I think that's the last of them.
I'm so glad
I got to talk to everyone. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Now, let's get to cleaning...

text_block_list.name: Curren Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Hey. Isn't that the runner who won
the
Japanese Oaks this year?

text_block_list.name: Curren Fan B
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh! Y-you're right! It is!

text_block_list.name: Curren Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Um! I've seen all of your races! Your
running has
really moved me!

text_block_list.name: Oaks Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh... Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Fan B
text_block_list.text: It's too bad about the Triple Tiara... But you were so strong and so... so... Sniff!

text_block_list.name: Curren Fan B
text_block_list.text:
SO COOL! I never thought I'd get to
meet you in
real life!

text_block_list.name: Oaks Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. I plan on running in the
Arima Kinen
too, so I hope you'll cheer
for me there!

text_block_list.name: Curren Fans
text_block_list.text:
Of course! We can't wait to see you in
another big
race!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...It really is all about the races.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
There's so much power in the races... It's
honestly
amazing. I think I have an
inkling of how those
fans feel.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You can't help but be dazzled by the
radiance of
athletes like that.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Big Bro?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Big Sis?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I think...
I really do want the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...I think it's time to see if I have
what it
takes to
compete in the Tiara.

She looks at me quite seriously. Even
with all the training we've done so far,
the Triple Tiara might
be a bit of a
stretch. But...

If she's serious about going for it,
as her
trainer, I
have to support her to the end!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks for backing my decision.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The first race, the Oka Sho, is 1,600
meters,
right? But since I'm best at
1,200-meter races...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Agreed!

If she does well in that race, she'll be
one step
closer to her dream of holding
the Triple Tiara!
choice_data_list: Then let's take on the Fillies' Revue.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I know. You can keep as close an eye on
me as
you want, okay?
choice_data_list: Still, if it turns out to be impos...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I know. You can keep as close an eye on
me as
you want, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But I don't think it'll be too much. I'll
definitely
show you I can do it!

And so, we decide on the Fillies' Revue
for her
next goal!
